first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and inherited evidence indicates that shortening onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, and early adoption, with signup simplification also lifting SMB activation. Verify the two most directly relevant archived records before committing; promotional pricing addresses competitor pressure but carries documented retention harm and is not the sustainable-revenue default.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening the onboarding flow. It directly addresses the 4% decline in onboarding completion and is the strongest verified sustainable-value option: exp_86 increased completion 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention 3%. Signup simplification also previously improved SMB activation. Activation messaging is a credible alternative, but its verified retention lift (+1%) was smaller and it does not directly repair completion. Promotional pricing is excluded because prior evidence showed material 30-day retention harm.
